title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
excerpt: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
content_html:
Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg is trying to sell investors on his prediction for the future — one where billions of people will have their own personal AI agents in the next five years. (Let's hope that future also comes with data centers efficient enough to power all those agents — without triggering a fresh wave of climate disasters.)

"I think that it's extremely unlikely if you look out five years from now, for example — whatever period of time you want — that you don't have billions of people with a personal agent that understands your goals and that is just working on your behalf 24/7 to achieve your goals in whatever the domain is that you care about," Zuckerberg said on Wednesday's quarterly earnings call with investors.

He added that he could see people using these agents to help them with their finances, health, interpersonal relationships, and household management.

"As we move toward a future where we're all interacting with multiple agents, I think that WhatsApp and our other messaging surfaces are going to become increasingly important," he said, noting that WhatsApp is already the leading platform where users interact with Meta AI.

Meta is not alone in setting high expectations for AI systems that can act on a person's behalf rather than just answer questions. Google emphasized custom AI agents as a key new feature in its Search overhaul, which sparked outcry from users who felt bogged down by the constant onslaught of AI results on Google. Meanwhile, subscriptions to Anthropic's Claude have skyrocketed as engineers fawn over the agentic coding assistant Claude Code.

Compared to its competitors, however, Meta may not enjoy as much confidence from investors as it continues dumping cash into innovative projects that may or may not pan out — Meta's stock dropped almost 10% after posting this quarter's earnings. Meta's Reality Labs, the organization responsible for its AR glasses, VR headsets, and related software, lost around $4.6 billion this quarter, roughly in line with the losses the division has posted each quarter since 2021. That's a running total now of around $88 billion.

Meta's AI spending is likely to climb even higher, which is more of a concern at this juncture. The company reported free cash flow of $784 million this quarter, down from $8.55 billion the same quarter last year. That's a 91% drop year over year, exacerbated by the company's investments in AI infrastructure. This week, Meta and BlackRock announced a partnership to build a $14 billion data center in El Paso, Texas.

content_html_zh:
Meta 创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格正试图向投资者推销他对未来的预测——未来五年内，数十亿人将拥有自己的个人人工智能代理。 （我们希望未来数据中心的效率足以为所有这些代理提供动力，而不会引发新一波的气候灾难。）

扎克伯格在周三与投资者举行的季度财报电话会议上表示：“我认为，如果你从现在起五年后展望，无论你想要什么时间段，你都不太可能看到数十亿人拥有一位了解你的目标的个人代理人，并且他们会全天候（24/7）代表你工作，以实现你在任何你关心的领域的目标。”

他补充说，他可以看到人们使用这些代理来帮助他们处理财务、健康、人际关系和家庭管理。

“随着我们走向与多个代理交互的未来，我认为 WhatsApp 和我们的其他消息传递界面将变得越来越重要，”他说，并指出 WhatsApp 已经是用户与 Meta AI 交互的领先平台。

Meta 并不是唯一一家对人工智能系统寄予厚望的公司，因为人工智能系统不仅可以回答问题，而且可以代表人类行事。 谷歌强调定制人工智能代理是其搜索改革中的一项关键新功能，这引发了用户的强烈抗议，他们因人工智能结果对谷歌的不断冲击而陷入困境。 与此同时，随着工程师们对代理编码助手 Claude Code 的奉承，Anthropic 的 Claude 的订阅量猛增。

然而，与竞争对手相比，Meta 可能没有得到投资者那么多的信心，因为它继续将现金投入到可能成功也可能失败的创新项目中——Meta 的股价在发布本季度收益后下跌了近 10%。 Meta 旗下的 Reality Labs 是负责 AR 眼镜、VR 耳机和相关软​​件的组织，本季度亏损约 46 亿美元，大致与该部门自 2021 年以来每个季度公布的亏损额一致。 目前总计约为 880 亿美元。

Meta 的人工智能支出可能会攀升得更高，这是目前更令人担忧的问题。 该公司报告本季度自由现金流为 7.84 亿美元，低于去年同期的 85.5 亿美元。 由于该公司对人工智能基础设施的投资，这一数字同比下降了 91%。 本周，Meta 和 BlackRock 宣布合作，在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索建设一座耗资 140 亿美元的数据中心。
